rules.text: Weight: parcels up to 30 kg ship on the standard service.
Weight, fragile: fragile parcels up to 20 kg ship on the standard service.
Batteries: loose lithium batteries never ship.
Batteries: lithium batteries installed in equipment ship on the standard service.
Same-day pickup: bookings made by 14:00 are picked up the same day.
Same-day pickup, Saturday: bookings made by 11:00 are picked up the same day.
Declared value: we cover parcels declared at up to 5000 dollars.
Remote zones: deliveries to remote postcodes carry a 12 dollar surcharge.
Liquids: liquids ship in packaging graded 3 or higher.

tests.ask: An 18 kg fragile parcel: standard service?
A box of loose lithium batteries: can it ship?
A drill with its battery installed: can it ship?
Booked at 14:00 on a Tuesday: same-day pickup?
Booked at 12:00 on a Saturday: same-day pickup?
A framed print declared at 1500 dollars: covered?
A delivery to a remote postcode: is there a surcharge?

changes.text: Weight: parcels up to 25 kg ship on the standard service; heavier parcels go as freight.
Same-day pickup, Saturday: bookings made by 12:00 are picked up the same day.
Declared value: cover applies to parcels declared at up to 5000 dollars, proof of value required.

rule.text: Declared value, artwork: artwork is covered up to 1000 dollars.

regression.commit: refactor: share one compare() for max and min
regression.bug: max rules compare with < instead of <=, so a value exactly at the limit is refused

A.title: A · no fixture: read live memory
A.how: the tests read today's `fact list` at test time

B.title: B · pin the fact ids
B.how: at pin time the fixture saves the 9 fact ids (fixtures/ids.json); the tests load each id with `fact get`; the fixture check is: every pinned id still resolves

C.title: C · pin the content
C.how: at pin time the fixture saves every fact as read: id, text, metadata, updated_at and a sha256 of the three (fixtures/snapshot.json); the tests read only this file; a separate drift check compares it with live memory and does not fail the build
